createScan.creditsLoadFailedBody: You can submit the study without an expert review and request one later from the scan.

createScan.creditWillBeSpent: One credit from {{label}} will be spent on submit
createScan.creditSpentOnSubmit: The credit is only spent once the study is submitted. If the request fails you will be told, and the study is saved either way.

files.failedBody: Each one says why below. Retrying re-uploads only that file; everything already in storage stays put.

fileRow.structureOnlyTitle: The file is a valid, complete container, but this browser cannot decode its codec. It uploads normally and the server can read it.
fileRow.detachedBody: This file was in the saved draft but its contents were not kept in the browser. Choose the same file again to finish uploading it, or remove it from the study.

rail.localPlayback: Playing from this browser — nothing is fetched back from storage. Use

summary.title: What will be sent
summary.blurb: Everything below is recorded against the files already in storage. Group routing cannot be changed afterwards.
summary.noNote: No note. A reviewer will see the findings and the images only.
summary.noGroups: No groups. No group reviewer will see this study, and a group cannot be added to it afterwards — the API has no route for that. You can still share it with named people from the study itself.

page.title: Create scan study
page.blurb: Files upload while you work. Submitting records the details against them.
page.discardTitle: Discard this draft and start again
page.restoredTitle: Picked up where you left off
page.restoredBody: A saved draft was found in this browser. Files that finished uploading are already in storage, and anything that was still transferring picks up where it stopped. Only a file this browser no longer holds has to be chosen again — those are listed as such.

classic.addFile: Add at least one file to continue.
classic.chooseType: Choose a scan type to continue.

interpretation.scanTypeBlurb: Required, and fixed once the study is submitted — the API has no way to change a scan’s type afterwards.

routing.submitBlurb: Your files are already in storage. Submitting records the study’s details against them — it does not start another upload.
routing.stillMovingBody: Submitting now creates the study with the {{stored}} already in storage and leaves the rest out. Wait for them to finish, or go back and deal with the ones that failed.
routing.nothingStoredBody: A study cannot be created without at least one uploaded file — the API rejects a file total of zero.
routing.noExamTypeBody: A study needs an exam type: it decides which findings a reviewer is asked, and it cannot be changed once the study exists.
routing.notSubmittedBody: Your uploaded files are still in storage and this draft is saved, so nothing has to be re-done.

submitted.title: Study submitted
submitted.blurb: The study is in your vault. Processing and de-identification finish on the server a few seconds from now; the list updates itself.
submitted.expertFailedTitle: The expert review request did not go through
submitted.expertFailedBody: The study itself is saved and routed to your groups, and no credit was spent.
